verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Recurly serves an llms.txt index at docs.recurly.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200). Section-level llms.txt files exist for Engage and RevRec, and doc pages are published as .md files, so agents have machine-readable docs to work from. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using these files, and first-party docs describing the llms.txt and agent-docs offering itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
